client.enableEmptySecret.hint: Enable it to set empty client secret. Public clients do not need a secret.
client.scope.hint:
Comma separated list of scopes. Scopes should have the following structure: ENTITY.OPERATION. See the radar-auth library documentation for more information.
ENTITY is any of SOURCETYPE, SOURCEDATA, SOURCE, SUBJECT, USER, ROLE, PROJECT, OAUTHCLIENTS, AUDIT, AUTHORITY, MEASUREMENT and OPERATION is any of CREATE, UPDATE, READ, WRITE.
